patches.reason: The pinned TCK cannot attach the Bearer credential required by Kyber's declared profile. A loopback-only wrapper injects the least-privilege fixture credential without modifying upstream source.
The pinned TCK reuses message IDs with different request bodies across independent tests. The wrapper isolates only conflicting cross-test IDs while preserving identical idempotent replays.

The pinned DM-MSG-001 test incorrectly requires SendMessage to return the Message union variant although A2A also permits a Task, and CORE-SEND-003 omits its expected error declaration and rejects the required ContentTypeNotSupportedError. Kyber supplemental tests retain both normative checks.
